title: Night-long Embrace
style: Neo-soul R&B, mellow close-mic baritone with fluid, clean enunciation and clipped rhythmic staccato phrasing; warm Rhodes, soft brushed drums, soft harmony pads beneath the chorus; tape-saturated production; quiet, unhurried groove.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Sand washed off, lights low in the cabin
You already know the usual way we do this
Detached, clean, therapeutic distance
A method that works until it doesn’t

Tonight I don’t want the script
I don’t want the careful hands
I just want the weight of you
Against me until morning

[Chorus]
Just sleep with me tonight
No performance, no exchange
I might wake up wanting more
Or I might not
But I’d really appreciate
A night-long embrace

[Verse 2]
You’re the one who usually holds the frame
Unorthodox, still the one in charge
I know the clause, I know the boundaries
I know why we keep it this way

But right now the secrecy feels heavy
And the rebuild feels endless
All I need is someone who doesn’t need
An explanation from me

[Chorus]
Just sleep with me tonight
No performance, no exchange
I might wake up wanting more
Or I might not
But I’d really appreciate
A night-long embrace

[Bridge]
You can say no
You can keep the distance
You can remind me who we are
Outside this cabinOr you can stay
And let the night be simple
No diagnosis
Just the sound of two people breathing

[Final Chorus]
Just sleep with me tonight
No performance, no exchange
I might wake up wanting more
Or I might not
But I’d really appreciate
A night-long embrace

[Outro]
Stay
That’s all
Stay
